# deep-research-os

> An open-source research operating system for AI agents. Every claim traces to a verbatim quote, every source to a SHA-256 snapshot, every report to hard gates. MIT, zero API keys.

Version 1.2.0 · MIT · Nariman Khaleghi

## Pages

- English: https://narimankhaleghi.github.io/deep-research-os/

- Sample report (FA): https://narimankhaleghi.github.io/deep-research-os/fa/samples/report.html

## What it does

- Evidence ledger: Every claim carries a verbatim quote and a locator; every source carries a SHA-256 snapshot of what was actually read.
- Citation verification: DOI and citation resolution, online and offline. Fabricated references and number drift never make it into the report.
- Contradiction protocol: Conflicts are recorded, graded and adjudicated, with severity and resolution kept on the record.
- Requirement coverage: Every prompt requirement is mapped to an anchor that appears in the report, or waived with a stated reason.
- PRISMA-lite search log: Every query is journaled with an ID, engine, hit count and screening outcome. Reproducible by default.
- Bilingual reports: Persian and English reports with real RTL, light and dark themes, embedded fonts, and clean A4 print output.

## Install

1. Clone: `git clone https://github.com/NarimanKhaleghi/deep-research-os`
2. Install the skill: `./install.sh`
3. Verify: `python scripts/research_ctl.py doctor`
4. Start a run: `python scripts/research_ctl.py init "Your research question" --profile deep --dir ~/Research/your-topic`
